// diagnostic E0225

Jet.UnusedPlaceMark

This mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

What

This mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

Why

A mark belongs only on a call's receiver or argument that the callee writes or takes, before a changeable name, and on `task ^^name`; a write window is `place.in_place()`, and `x.move()` takes a name or one of its fields. Read calls and fresh values such as literals and call results take no mark, and a collection element stays in its collection.

Fix

Remove the mark.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnusedPlaceMark: Tests/UI/move_mark_borrowed.stderr.

Error: Jet.MissingMoveMarker: `xs` cannot be moved from borrowed storage
  --> Tests/UI/move_mark_borrowed.jet:7:38
    |
  7 | wrap: fn(xs: [Int]) -> Box { Box{xs: xs.move()} }
    |                                      ^^^^^^^
 Why: Read and write parameters and named windows keep ownership with their source
 Fix: Copy the value with `xs.copy()`, or declare the parameter `xs: ^^[Int]` to take ownership
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.MissingMoveMarker

Error: Jet.UnusedPlaceMark: `.move()` takes a named place, not this value
  --> Tests/UI/move_mark_borrowed.jet:13:13
    |
 13 |     ^first: grid[0].move()
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `.move()` moves a name or one of its fields out of its owner; an element stays owned by its collection, and a call result or literal is already new
 Fix: Move the whole collection or name, or drop `.move()` from a fresh value
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.UnusedPlaceMark
